label: Hard Rock / Heavy Metal with East Asian stylistic influences

cards.mood: The piece opens with a dramatic, cinematic tension that immediately erupts into a high-octane, aggressive drive.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and melodic engine, present from the very first second to the final chord.

[Intro]
[Verse]
Shadows stretch across the jagged peaks
Iron blood flows through the veins of stone
A warrior stands where the silence speaks
